# CEleste

Port of Celeste Classic (Maddy Thorson and Noel Berry, PICO-8, 2015) to the TI-84 Plus CE by commandz (John Cesarz).
File CELESTE.8xp is the unmodified release from https://www.ticalc.org/pub/84plusce/asm/games/celeste.zip.

Licence: MIT (see LICENSE, copyright Noel Berry). Source repository: https://github.com/commandblockguy/CEleste.
Needs the CE C libraries.
